goal.en: Stay calm before the interview and answer "Tell me about yourself" with a clear story.
goal.zh: 面試前保持冷靜，並用清楚的架構回答「介紹一下你自己」。

background: modern office meeting room with warm pendant lamps over a long wooden table, glass wall facing an open office, potted plants, water glasses on a tray, afternoon light

intro.en: Thursday, 1:50 p.m. The Brightway office glows with soft, warm light. Of course it does: they sell lights.
intro.zh: 星期四下午一點五十分。Brightway 的辦公室透著柔和的暖光。這也難怪，他們就是賣燈的。

intro.en: Rachel waves at you from across the room and walks you to a meeting room.
intro.zh: 瑞秋從另一頭向你揮手，帶你走進一間會議室。

lines.en: Kai, welcome! You're right on time. How are you feeling today?
lines.zh: 凱，歡迎！你很準時。今天感覺怎麼樣？

choices.en: A little nervous, but excited. Thanks for having me.
choices.zh: 有點緊張，但很興奮。謝謝你們邀請我來。
choices.tip: 坦白說有點緊張沒關係，加上 but excited 和道謝，聽起來就很正面。

choices.en: Very nervous! My English is so bad, please forgive me.
choices.zh: 超緊張！我的英文很爛，請多包涵。

lines.en: Your English is fine! Please don't say that in the interview, okay?
lines.zh: 你的英文沒問題啊！面試的時候千萬別這樣說，好嗎？

story.en: You say it to Ms. Wong anyway. She spends the first five minutes telling you that your English is fine, instead of asking about your skills.
story.zh: 你還是跟王經理說了一樣的話。她花了前五分鐘安慰你英文沒問題，而不是問你的能力。

fail.why: 「請多包涵」是台灣的客套，但在英文面試中先貶低自己，只會讓對方注意你的弱點。說 A little nervous, but excited. 就好。

choices.en: I'm very tension now. My heart is jumping so fast.
choices.zh: 我現在很緊張，心跳超快。

lines.en: Tension? Your heart is jumping? Should I get you some water, or a doctor?
lines.zh: Tension？你的心在跳？要不要我拿杯水給你，還是叫醫生？

story.en: Rachel brings you water, a chair by the window and the office first aid kit. You feel fine, just very embarrassed.
story.zh: 瑞秋拿來一杯水、搬了張窗邊的椅子，還帶來辦公室的急救箱。你身體沒事，只是非常尷尬。

fail.why: tension 是名詞「緊張的狀態」，形容自己緊張要說 I'm nervous.；「心跳很快」直譯也很怪，說 I've got butterflies in my stomach. 更自然。

lines.en: Ms. Wong will be right with you. Can I get you some water while you wait?
lines.zh: 王經理馬上就來。等的時候要不要喝杯水？

choices.en: No, no, no, don't trouble yourself! I'm fine.
choices.zh: 不用不用不用，別麻煩了！我沒關係。

story.en: Rachel takes your 'no' at face value. Twenty minutes into the interview, your voice sounds like sandpaper.
story.zh: 瑞秋把你的「不用」當真了。面試進行到二十分鐘，你的聲音乾得像砂紙。

fail.why: 台灣人習慣先客氣推辭，但在這裡，對方會照字面接受你的「不用」。想要就直接說 Yes, please.，不要就說 No, thank you.。

choices.en: Yes, please. That would be great. Thank you, Rachel.
choices.zh: 好，麻煩你了，太好了。謝謝你，瑞秋。
choices.tip: 別人提供東西時，想要就直接說 Yes, please.，不必客套推辭。

choices.en: Do you have coffee instead? Water is a bit boring.

lines.en: We have water or tea. This isn't a café, Kai.
lines.zh: 我們只有水或茶。凱，這裡不是咖啡店。

story.en: Rachel brings you water anyway. When Ms. Wong arrives, Rachel whispers something to her, and they both glance at you.
story.zh: 瑞秋還是拿了一杯水給你。王經理進來時，瑞秋在她耳邊說了些什麼，兩人一起看了你一眼。

fail.why: 面試時把對方的招待當成點餐，還嫌水無聊，會顯得很挑剔。接受就說 Yes, please.，不需要就說 No, thank you.。

lines.en: Ms. Wong walks in, shakes your hand and sits across from you with a notepad.
lines.zh: 王經理走進來，和你握了握手，拿著筆記本坐到你對面。

lines.en: Thanks for coming in, Kai. So, tell me a little about yourself.
lines.zh: 凱，謝謝你過來。那麼，簡單介紹一下你自己吧。

choices.en: I was born in Taichung. My father is an engineer, and my mother teaches.
choices.zh: 我在台中出生。我爸爸是工程師，媽媽是老師。

lines.en: Your family sounds lovely. But I was hoping to hear about you and your work.
lines.zh: 你的家人聽起來很好。不過我比較想聽你自己和工作的事。

story.en: By the time you get to elementary school, Ms. Wong has checked her watch twice.
story.zh: 等你講到小學的時候，王經理已經看了兩次手錶。

fail.why: 在台灣自我介紹常從出生地、家庭講起，但面試的 Tell me about yourself 要講和工作有關的經歷。用「過去、現在、未來」的順序：I graduated..., now I'm..., I hope to...。

choices.en: I graduated from college in Taiwan last year. Now I'm studying English here.
choices.zh: 我去年在台灣大學畢業，現在在這裡學英文。
choices.tip: 用過去式說背景，再用現在進行式說現況，自我介紹就有清楚的時間線。

choices.en: I have graduated from college since last year, and now I study here.
choices.zh: 我從去年大學畢業，現在在這裡讀書。

lines.en: Since last year? So you've been graduating for a year? I'm a little lost.
lines.zh: 從去年開始？所以你畢業畢了一年？我有點聽不懂。

story.en: You spend the next two minutes untangling your own timeline. Ms. Wong draws a confused little arrow on her notepad.
story.zh: 接下來兩分鐘，你都在解開自己的時間線。王經理在筆記本上畫了一個困惑的小箭頭。

fail.why: 畢業是過去某個時間點完成的事，要用過去式：I graduated last year.。since 搭配現在完成式表示持續的狀態，例如 I've lived here since March.。

choices.en: I worked at a café, but the boss was terrible, so I quit after a year.
choices.zh: 我在咖啡店工作過，但老闆很糟，所以做了一年就辭了。

lines.en: I see. And what would you say about us, if you left someday?
lines.zh: 我懂了。那如果有一天你離職，你會怎麼說我們？

story.en: Ms. Wong's pen stops moving. The room suddenly feels a few degrees colder, even with all those warm lights.
story.zh: 王經理的筆停了下來。就算滿室暖光，房間也突然冷了好幾度。

fail.why: 面試時批評前老闆，會讓面試官擔心你以後也這樣說他們。只談你做了什麼、學到什麼：I worked at a design studio, doing product photos.。

choices.en: I worked part-time at a design studio, doing product photos and social media.
choices.zh: 我在一間設計工作室打工，負責商品攝影和社群媒體。
choices.tip: 說經驗時講出「在哪裡」和「做什麼」，用 doing + 名詞補充工作內容。

choices.en: I did part-time jobs at a café and a studio, so I have rich society experience.
choices.zh: 我在咖啡店和工作室打過工，所以有豐富的社會經驗。

lines.en: Rich society experience? Do you mean you've been to a lot of fancy parties?
lines.zh: 豐富的上流社會經驗？你是說你參加過很多高級派對嗎？

story.en: Ms. Wong now pictures you sipping champagne at a yacht party. It takes a while to bring her back to the café.
story.zh: 王經理腦中浮現你在遊艇派對上啜飲香檳的畫面。你花了好一會兒，才把她拉回咖啡店。

fail.why: 「豐富的社會經驗」直譯成 rich society experience，聽起來像出入上流社會。說 work experience，並舉出具體內容：I did product photos and social media.。

lines.en: Good. And where do you see yourself going from here?
lines.zh: 很好。那你接下來希望往哪個方向發展？

choices.en: Honestly? I just need any job before my visa runs out.
choices.zh: 老實說？我只是需要在簽證到期前找到任何工作。

lines.en: Any job? So this one isn't really special to you.
lines.zh: 任何工作？所以這份工作對你來說沒什麼特別的。

story.en: Ms. Wong closes her notepad a little early. Honesty is good, but this was a bit too much of it.
story.zh: 王經理提早闔上了筆記本。誠實是好事，但這次誠實過頭了。

fail.why: 說「只要有工作就好」，等於告訴面試官你對這個職位沒熱情。談未來要連結到這份工作：I hope to grow in sales and work with clients like hotels and cafés.。

choices.en: In the future? Hopefully living near the beach with two cats, haha!
choices.zh: 未來？希望住在海邊，養兩隻貓，哈哈！

lines.en: That sounds lovely... but I meant your career.
lines.zh: 聽起來很美好……不過我指的是你的職涯。

story.en: Ms. Wong smiles politely. She now knows your dream pets, but not your career goals.
story.zh: 王經理客氣地笑了笑。她現在知道你夢想中的寵物了，卻不知道你的職涯目標。

fail.why: 面試問 Where do you see yourself...? 是在問職涯方向，不是生活夢想。用 I hope to + 動詞 連結到這份工作。

choices.en: I hope to grow in sales and work with clients like hotels and cafés.
choices.zh: 我希望在業務方面成長，和飯店、咖啡店這類客戶合作。
choices.tip: 談未來用 I hope to + 動詞，並提到對方公司的客戶，顯示你做過功課。

lines.en: Ms. Wong writes something on her notepad and underlines it twice.
lines.zh: 王經理在筆記本上寫了些什麼，還畫了兩條底線。

lines.en: Clear and well organized. I like that. Let's keep going.
lines.zh: 清楚又有條理，我喜歡。我們繼續吧。

story.en: Your answer had a beginning, a middle and an end. The hardest question of the interview is behind you.
story.zh: 你的回答有開頭、有過程、有結尾。面試中最難的一題，已經順利過關。

notes.en: I graduated... Now I'm... I hope to...
notes.zh: 我畢業於……現在我在……我希望……
notes.explain: 回答 Tell me about yourself 的萬用架構：過去式說背景，現在式說現況，I hope to 說未來。整段控制在一分鐘左右。

example.en: I studied design. Now I'm working at a café. I hope to move into marketing.
example.zh: 我讀設計，現在在咖啡店工作，希望之後轉往行銷。

notes.en: I graduated last year. / I've lived here since March.
notes.zh: 我去年畢業。／我從三月起就住在這裡。
notes.explain: 某個時間點完成的事用過去式；從過去持續到現在的狀態，才用現在完成式加 since。

example.en: I moved here in March, and I've lived here since then.
example.zh: 我三月搬來，從那時起就住在這裡。

notes.explain: 「緊張」不說 I'm tension，tension 是名詞；「社會經驗」不說 society experience，要說 work experience。

example.en: I'm a little nervous, but I have three years of work experience.
example.zh: 我有點緊張，不過我有三年工作經驗。

notes.en: Tell me about yourself = your work story
notes.zh: 介紹你自己＝說你的工作故事
notes.explain: 面試的自我介紹不是從出生地和家人開始，也不要批評前老闆。挑和這份工作有關的經歷來說。

example.en: I've worked with customers for two years, and I enjoy it.
example.zh: 我和客人打交道兩年了，我很喜歡這份工作。

notes.explain: 別人請你喝水、喝茶時，對方會照字面理解你的回答。想要就說 Yes, please.，不用客氣推辭三次。

example.en: Would you like some tea? Yes, please. That would be lovely.
example.zh: 要喝茶嗎？好，麻煩你，太好了。
